title: SignalGraph named ports expose typed authoring diagnostics

needles: named graph ports report actionable diagnostics
named graph ports reject an instantaneous cycle with a message
MIDI graph ports retain their kind

installed_sdk.rationale: The host include tree installs signal_graph_node.hpp and signal_graph_runtime.hpp with the public host SDK; named PortHandle values and typed GraphResult diagnostics are therefore available to SDK graph authors.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline timeline CLI operation or document format changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: Named ports are an in-process graph authoring API and do not grant a new live product control surface.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time agent capability or manifest entry changes.
